title: unify-sdks-auth-retries-streaming-ergonomics-parity-v1.130.1
author: Priya Patel
description:
Summary: Unify auth and retry semantics across Python, TypeScript, and Go SDKs; improve streaming ergonomics and bring parity fixes for structured streaming and function-calling. This PR also bumps SDK versions to v1.130.1 and updates changelogs.

Motivation: Different SDKs had diverging behavior for token refresh, retry backoff, and streaming callbacks which led to inconsistent developer experience and subtle production bugs (stale tokens, double-retries on transient 5xx, and missing EOF semantics in TypeScript streams). This change centralizes core auth/retry contracts and harmonizes streaming surface area so client code can be ported across languages with minimal changes.

What changed (high level): Consolidated retry policy definitions (max_attempts, per-call timeout, jittered exponential backoff) and exposed a common config object across SDKs; implemented unified token refresh hook with singleflight suppression to avoid concurrent refreshes; standardized streaming APIs so Python/TS/Go expose on_message/on_close handlers and consistent end-of-stream semantics; fixed parity issues in TypeScript where function-calling events were emitted after stream close; improved ergonomics in Python client by providing typed response wrappers and context-manager support for streaming sessions.

Testing: Added cross-language unit tests for retry backoff sequences, integration tests that simulate transient errors and token rotation, and end-to-end streaming smoke tests against the local dev server. CI matrix covers all three runtimes and runs the streaming conformance suite.

Notes for reviewers: I kept behavioral changes behind opt-in flags where there was potential customer impact (see python-sdk:ClientConfig.enable_unified_retry and ts-sdk:ClientOptions.unifiedRetries). Once we validate in canary, these flags will default on in the next minor release.

Related: Linear ENG-3124 (unify sdk runtime behaviors), SUP-1984 incident follow-up, and the docs PR that will land in redwood-docs to document the new streaming ergonomics and migration guide.

release_notes: v1.130.1: Unified auth token refresh and retry semantics across SDKs; streaming API parity and ergonomics improvements; minor breaking opt-in flags for unified retry behavior (off by default). See docs/migration/sdks-unified-retries.md for migration steps.
notes_for_ops: Canary rollout recommended: enable unified retry flag for 5% of traffic on Dedicated and Hosted to validate backoff behavior against transient 5xx before full rollout.
migration_steps: Python: set ClientConfig(enable_unified_retry=True) to opt into new retry semantics
TypeScript: migrate from stream.on('message') to client.stream(onMessage, onClose) wrapper or enable ClientOptions.unifiedRetries
